planets.name: HD 15337 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 15337 with a 4.76-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: HD 15337 b was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HD 15337. Its orbit and size follow Rosário et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
